# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P45](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0045), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Bill  <sub>[v3 c8 P14](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, twenty-year-old young man with a round, expressionless, freckled face.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

## Personality

Barney possesses an extreme inability to hold a conversation and rarely speaks or laughs, though he smiles joyfully when pleased. Despite his quiet nature, he is an emotionless young man who is bashful around women. When seeking a wife, he resorts to having his sister propose on his behalf out of timidity, but he handles rejection practically and quickly moves on.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## Goals

- To marry and establish a home on his farm  <sub>[v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney drove a double-seated buggy carrying Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and his sister Odette to and from a concert at the Pale Sands Hotel. He harbored a silent admiration for Nell Harcourt and frequently sought her proximity. Upon receiving the upper farm in his name from his father, he sought to take a wife. Too bashful to ask directly, he persuaded his sister Odette to propose to Nell on his behalf, offering to wait until she finished college. When Nell declined, he accepted her decision without heartbreak and married Nettie Scobie during the following summer.

_Sources: [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P17](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0017), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
